description.value: The Greek Islands Chilliwack (GI 2) is an award-winning, family-owned Greek restaurant at the corner of Hocking Avenue and Yale Road, one of three Fraser Valley locations operated by the Sahamis family who emigrated from Sparta, Greece, and opened their first restaurant in Abbotsford in 1982. The Chilliwack location offers full dine-in service as well as takeout via in-house ordering and SkipTheDishes. A sit-down meal of Greek and international cuisine makes it a substantial refuelling option for cyclists passing through Chilliwack.
